newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Apr-Aug tax collections up by 16 pct - CMIE.
newsitem.headline: India's Apr-Aug tax collections up by 16 pct - CMIE.

text.p: Taxes collected by the Indian government during April-August 1996 were 400.72 billion rupees, a 16 percent increase over the same period last year, the Centre for Monitoring Indian Economy (CMIE) said in a report released on Wednesday.
Tax collections are budgeted to rise by 17.3 percent during 1996/97 (April-March), the Bombay-based research firm said.
CMIE said the growth in direct tax receipts during the six months ended September 30, 1996 was 15 percent against a target of 17 percent for 1996/97.
The report said receipts from corporate taxes during the period were 65.04 billion rupees against 63.28 billion in the same period last year.
Income-tax collections rose by 22 percent to 67.89 billion rupees, it said.
